moments.title: Premier League Kicks Off
moments.blurb: The 2026/27 Premier League season is scheduled to begin on Friday, August 21, with the first full round of fixtures over the weekend.

angles.name: Anticipation
angles.copy: The wait is almost over! Premier League football is BACK this coming weekend. Who are you backing for the title?

angles.name: First Fixtures
angles.copy: That new season buzz! The Premier League 2026/27 season kicks off this Friday. Any early shocks or big statements from your team?

angles.name: Weekend Ready
angles.copy: Goal alerts are ringing! The Premier League is back on our screens from Friday. Get ready for a season of drama.

moments.title: Community Shield Today
moments.blurb: The 2026 Community Shield, featuring Premier League champions Arsenal and FA Cup winners Manchester City, is being played today at Principality Stadium in Cardiff.

angles.name: Match Day
angles.copy: It's match day for the Community Shield! Arsenal vs Man City at Principality Stadium in Cardiff. Who's taking home the first silverware of the season?

angles.name: Cardiff Host
angles.copy: Cardiff is buzzing today as Principality Stadium hosts the Community Shield! A huge game between Arsenal and Man City right here in Wales.

angles.name: Season Curtain-Raiser
angles.copy: The official curtain-raiser for the English football season is here! Arsenal face Manchester City in the Community Shield today.

moments.title: Green Man Festival Concludes
moments.blurb: The Green Man Festival, one of Wales' most popular independent music festivals, concludes today in the Brecon Beacons.

angles.name: Last Day Vibes
angles.copy: Last day vibes at Green Man! Who caught some incredible acts in the Brecon Beacons this weekend?

angles.name: Welsh Festival Wrap
angles.copy: Mud, music & magic! Green Man Festival 2026 finishes up today in the beautiful Brecon Beacons. What's been your highlight?

angles.name: Packing Up Memories
angles.copy: Packing up the tents and memories! Green Man Festival says 'Hwyl Fawr' for another year. Already planning 2027?
